name: Recording studio

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Nico and Priya (engineers at the studio)

services.name: 3-hour tracking session
services.story: The main story: a 3-hour tracking session with an engineer, $360, paid in full when booking.

services.name: 1-hour mixing session
services.story: A 1-hour mixing session, $120. A card is saved for the $40 no-show fee, and Alex pays at the front desk after.

services.name: 1-hour mastering session
services.story: A 1-hour mastering session, $150. A card is saved, and charged at DONE when the final files are sent.

services.name: album block (10 hours)
services.story: The 10-hour album block: a $200 deposit now, and the $800 rest paid at the studio at the last session.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Theo and Mara (engineers who travel to homes and venues)
B.customer: Alex M. (artist, the booker) · other customers

services.name: location recording (3 hours)
services.story: The main story: a 3-hour location recording at Alex's home, $450. The saved card is charged at DONE.

services.name: mix check at home
services.story: A $120 mix check at the customer's home, paid in full.

services.name: multi-visit location shoot
services.story: A multi-visit location shoot: a $600 deposit on the $2,400 estimate, and the $1,800 rest on the bill after the last visit.

services_shape: a room and an engineer for a block of hours (tracking, mixing, mastering); an album block booked as several sessions; location recording at a home or venue with a mobile rig (flow B)
questions_before_times: new or returning, and the kind of session: tracking, mixing, mastering, or an album block
how many songs and about how long
how many people play (a band) and the instruments
for flow B: the place, and whether there is power and room for the rig
safety_stop: fire or smoke from the gear or the room right now, or someone burned, shocked or hurt by the equipment
license: none checked by Rosie: a recording studio needs no state license in most places; the business registration is the owner's own word; a studio's insurance is optional for the booking
staff_skills: tracking, mixing, mastering, live recording, location recording, and vocal and drum sessions
messages_never: health and hearing answers, minors' details, and performer releases never go in a text: only the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
